review: A dodge tank, She encourages you to play defensive skill and rewards you for it. Although she already has good speed. Her skill and passive has speed manipulations allowing her to buff her coin power both on skills and dodge. Her third skill allows you to gain poise potency based on number of clashes, letting her crit and do decent damage with S3 Her downside is that shes pretty much a dead unit if her dodges lands on tails, but because of being able to lower her stagger threshold she allows some room for mistakes. Notable E.G.O Synergy Sunshower Outis - This ego is litteraly made for her. She gets better poise generation and helps with survivability if her dodges doesn’t connect
